treaties.title: Convention between the Government of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland and the Government of the Republic of India for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion with respect to Taxes on Income and Capital Gains

withholding.condition: Dividends paid out of income (including gains) derived directly or indirectly from immovable property by an investment vehicle which distributes most of this income annually and whose income from such immovable property is exempted from tax
withholding.quote: a) 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends where those dividends are paid out of income (including gains) derived directly or indirectly from immovable property within the meaning of Article 6 by an investment vehicle which distributes most of this income annually and whose income from such immovable property is exempted from tax;

withholding.condition: All other cases (the beneficial owner is a resident of the other Contracting State)
withholding.quote: b) 10 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends, in all other cases.

withholding.condition: General rate (the beneficial owner is a resident of the other Contracting State)
withholding.quote: provided that where the resident of the other Contracting State is the beneficial owner of the interest the tax so charged shall not exceed 15 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.

withholding.condition: Interest paid to a bank carrying on a bona fide banking business which is a resident of the other Contracting State and is the beneficial owner (Article 12(3)(a); interest paid to the Government, a political subdivision, a local authority or the Reserve Bank of India is exempt in the source State, Article 12(3)(b))
withholding.quote: a) where the interest is paid to a bank carrying on a bona fide banking business which is a resident of the other Contracting State and is the beneficial owner of the interest, the tax charged in the Contracting State in which the interest arises shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest;

withholding.condition: Royalties within Article 13(3)(a) (copyrights, patents, trade marks, designs, secret formulas, information concerning industrial, commercial or scientific experience), during the years after the first five years for which the Convention has effect
withholding.quote: (ii) during subsequent years, 15 per cent of the gross amount of such royalties or fees for technical services; and

withholding.condition: Royalties within Article 13(3)(b) (the use of, or the right to use, industrial, commercial or scientific equipment)
withholding.quote: b) in the case of royalties within paragraph (3)(b) of this Article and fees for technical services defined in paragraph (4)(b) of this Article, 10 per cent of the gross amount of such royalties and fees for technical services.

withholding.condition: Fees for technical services within Article 13(4)(a) and (c), during the years after the first five years for which the Convention has effect
withholding.quote: (ii) during subsequent years, 15 per cent of the gross amount of such royalties or fees for technical services; and

withholding.condition: Fees for technical services defined in Article 13(4)(b) (ancillary and subsidiary to the enjoyment of equipment royalties)
withholding.quote: b) in the case of royalties within paragraph (3)(b) of this Article and fees for technical services defined in paragraph (4)(b) of this Article, 10 per cent of the gross amount of such royalties and fees for technical services.

source.title: UK/India Double Taxation Convention signed 25 January 1993, as amended by a Protocol signed on 30 October 2012 (HM Revenue & Customs consolidated text, GOV.UK)
source.instrument: India-United Kingdom double taxation convention of 25 January 1993 as amended in 2012, Articles 11, 12, 13 and 24
source.quote: UK/ INDIA DOUBLE TAXATION CONVENTION SIGNED 25 JANUARY 1993 As amended by a Protocol signed on 30 October 2012 Entered into force on 25 October 1993
